Class PeeringIntelligence.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.PeeringIntelligence.Builder
Enclosing class:
PeeringIntelligence
public static class PeeringIntelligence.Builder extends Object
Fluent builder for configuring and executing a peering intelligence analysis.

The builder collects target ASNs (with optional labels), customer metro locations, the customer's own ASN, and analysis options. Calling analyze() executes the analysis pipeline and returns a PeeringIntelligenceResult.

Author:
ianjones

    • customerAsn

      public PeeringIntelligence.Builder customerAsn(long asn)
      Sets the customer's own ASN for mutual peering opportunity discovery.

      When provided, the engine queries PeeringDB for the customer's IX presence and identifies Equinix IXes where both the customer and a target ASN are connected — one opportunity per (target ASN, IX). PeeringDB records IX membership only, so an opportunity means mutual presence; whether the two networks already peer there cannot be determined from this data.

      Parameters:
      asn - the customer's autonomous system number
      Returns:
      this builder

    • includeResiliency

      public PeeringIntelligence.Builder includeResiliency(boolean include)
      Enables resiliency analysis (blast radius, correlated failures, failover paths).

      Requires customerMetros(MetroCode...) to have been called with at least one metro. Without customer metros, there is no context for evaluating failure impact.

      Parameters:
      include - true to perform resiliency analysis
      Returns:
      this builder

    • includeAll

      public PeeringIntelligence.Builder includeAll()
      Enables every analysis feature the engine actually performs: IX port-capacity analysis, peering-policy analysis, and resiliency analysis. (Capacity and policies are already on by default; this method additionally turns on the default-off resiliency analysis, which also requires at least one customer metro.)
      Returns:
      this builder

    • analyze

      public PeeringIntelligenceResult analyze()
      Executes the peering intelligence analysis.

      This method makes live API calls to PeeringDB (and optionally the Equinix Fabric API) to collect network presence data, then runs the analysis pipeline to produce the result.

      Returns:
      the complete analysis result
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no target ASNs have been specified
      RuntimeException - if PeeringDB API calls fail
